info.name: SecureScan API
info.description: Run the folders in order (Collection Runner). Folder 0 sets a unique suffix. These requests have NOT been executed by the author; run them against your local instance.

request.description: Sets {{suffix}} so usernames/emails are unique on every run.

exec: pm.test("status is PENDING and completedAt null", function () { var d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(d.completedAt).to.eql(null); });
